description: A slow or failed dependency exhausts its callers' workers, so the failure spreads from service to service.
An upper bound on how long a remote call may take, which turns a stuck call into a failure the caller can handle.
Each retry waits `base * 2^attempt`, bounded by a cap, so an overloaded dependency gets time to recover.
The retry delay is a random value between zero and the capped backoff, which spreads clients apart instead of retrying in waves.
A limit on retries as a fraction of normal traffic, so retries at several layers cannot multiply the load during an outage.
Closed counts failures, open fails fast without calling the dependency, half-open lets a few trial requests (often one) decide whether to close again.
A separate connection pool, thread pool or concurrency limit per dependency, so one slow dependency cannot use every worker.
Rejecting excess requests early with 503 or 429 so the accepted ones still finish within their deadline.
